meta.name: RDP access from the Internet should be blocked
meta.description: Stricter than the source: Azure refuses a rule only when access, direction, port and source all match at once; Tirith cannot bind four tests to one rule, so any inbound allow rule from the Internet is refused whatever its port. Port ranges like 3000-4000 are not expressible.

evaluators.description: Detects rules whose source is the Internet. With direction and access folded into the plan under review, this is the test that carries the intent
